{"tool":"execute","arguments":{"code":"import json, itertools
w=json.loads(context)
qs=w['quotes']
skus=sorted({q['sku'] for q in qs})
by={s:[q for q in qs if q['sku']==s and q['quality']=='approved' and q['units']>=w['demands'][s] and q['units']<=w['demands'][s]+2 and q['arrival']<=w['deadlines'][s]] for s in skus}
best=None
for choice in itertools.product(*(by[s] for s in skus)):
    if len({q['vendor'] for q in choice})<3 or sum(q['carbon'] for q in choice)>w['carbon_cap']: continue
    if any(q.get('needs_same_vendor_sku') and next(x for x in choice if x['sku']==q['needs_same_vendor_sku'])['vendor']!=q['vendor'] for q in choice): continue
    total=0; valid=True
    for v in {q['vendor'] for q in choice}:
        group=[q for q in choice if q['vendor']==v]; units=sum(q['units'] for q in group)
        if units>w['unit_cap'][v]: valid=False; break
        gross=sum(q['units']*q['unit_cents'] for q in group)
        terms=w['vendors'][v]
        merch=(gross*(10000-terms['tier_bps'])+5000)//10000 if units>=terms['tier_units'] else gross
        total+=merch
        if gross<terms['free_shipping_gross']: total+=terms['shipping_cents']
        if len({q['sku'] for q in group})>=2 and merch>=terms['rebate_merchandise_min']: total-=terms['rebate_cents']
    if valid and (best is None or total<best): best=total
print(FINAL(str(best)))"}}
